Rationale: the #8195 ruling named `II18nService.getDefaultLocale()` as the recipient-locale source; PR #9134's `normalizeAuthEmailLocale` adapts the two value spaces and is pinned in both directions, so shipped behaviour is correct for every shipped locale. The residual question — which axis wins when the catalog language and `localization.locale` disagree — has zero measured pull (no deployment has reported mismatched auth-mail language), and reversing later is a one-line source swap plus deleting the normalizer; nothing accrues by keeping the card open. The existing ruling stands as the decision of record.

Reopen is free if a real deployment hits the disagreement; the maintainer can veto this closure.
